identity.one_line: A modular alchemist healer. Ingredients, Bases, and Mojos change the effects of the Cauldron and Potion Toss, so the player prepares the right brew for steady healing, shields, raid healing, or damage support. It is flexible and utility-rich, but less plug-and-play than a conventional direct healer.

modes.name: Tiki Splash
modes.structural_description: While a Base is active, Spirit in a Bottle will now transform into Tiki Splash.Tiki SplashSplash target location with healing waters, healing for 34 + 25% SP every 1 sec for 5 seconds. Gains a new effect based on your currently active Base. Scales with modifiers to Spirit in a Bottle.Beast Blood: Grants you 5% increased critical strike chance for 15 seconds, stacking 2 times.Crystal Water: Grants you a shield that absorbs 422 + 75% SP Magic damage for 15 seconds.
